text:
anika: Heads-up — partner reported hour->minute aggregation mismatch causing double credits for some devices. sample from vendor shows minute buckets with partial overlaps.

mike: ugh. Which partner? hw-appliance team?

anika: EdgeWave SI. They send minute-level usage but also their collector sends hourly rollups. Our marketplace ingest dedupe is keyed by (device_id, window_start). With minute->hour mapping we see overlaps when hour aligns at :00 and minute stream contains that same :00 minute.

josh: Can we dedupe by source_id + seq_no? They don't include seq_no.

sara: Proposed options: 1) prefer highest granularity (minute) and ignore hourly when minute exists; 2) canonicalize vendor to hourly with floor-to-hour; 3) mark overlapping as partial and credit pro-rata. Need tradeoffs for billing consistency.

marketplace-bot: [automated] SLA impact: potential underbilling window if we drop minute and accept hourly. Flagging customers with >1% variance.

mike: For short term, can we backfill credits with a one-time reconcile run for last 30 days? Needs partner consent.

anika: partner ok with backfill but wants idempotent run. We'll need mapping script. Pseudocode:

```json
{"group_by": "device_id, hour_floor", "action": "prefer_minute_sum_if_exists_else_hour"}
```

sara: Also check timezone handling — partner sends times in UTC but metadata marked local TZ sometimes. Last incident was tz shift causing misaligned windows.

josh: I'll open a runbook and add a contract change: require source_version + sample payload and timezone field. Also request event_id for dedupe.

mike: timeline? We should ship quick fix to ingest (prefer minute) by EOD and schedule backfill next week.

anika: ok I'll coordinate with Eng-Platform and Partner Success. @sara can you prepare partner-facing note summarizing credits and rollback plan?

sara: on it. draft in #partners-drafts and will ping for signoff.

mike: thanks. keeping this thread for action.
